verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a terminal emulator, but the evidence documents no natural-language command interface in Ghostty. It shows only keybindings, config options, CLI +actions, AppleScript and Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents) automation. These are structured scripting surfaces or host-platform hooks, not natural-language control, and the runtime probe found no remote-control interface an agent could use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
